models.name: todo_list_guests
models.description:
Guest users who access the system without authentication.

Stores minimal identifying information for tracking purposes.
Guests do not have sessions since they are unauthenticated.

Used for analytics, monitoring, and optionally restricting access based on IP or device.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address of the guest user for tracking and access control.

plainFields.name: user_agent
plainFields.description: User agent string of the guest browser or client device.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Time when the guest record was created.

models.name: todo_list_users
models.description:
Authenticated users of the Todo List application.

Users must register with a unique email and password hash.

Manages user identity, authentication credentials, and account metadata.

Supports authentication workflows and user-specific todo data access controls.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for user login and communication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password string for user authentication. Never store plain text passwords.

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description:
Sessions for authenticated users of the Todo List application.

Tracks active and historical login sessions for users.

Records connection context such as IP, referrer, and access URL.

Supports session expiration and audit logging.

Each session links to its owning user.

This table has a composite index on user_id and created_at to optimize session queries.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the session was established.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session expired or was terminated.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description:
User personal todo items managed independently.

Each todo item belongs to one authenticated user and contains essential task information including title, optional description, status, and optional due date. The status field tracks task progression with values for pending, completed, and deleted states.

Timestamps created_at and updated_at support auditability and record changes over time. Permanent deletion is enforced without soft delete fields.

The user_id foreign key ensures ownership linkage to the users in the Actors component.

This table is the primary entity for the todo management domain, supporting all CRUD operations for personal todo items.

primaryField.name: id
primaryField.description: Primary key identifier for each todo item.

foreignFields.name: user_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the owning user. {@link todo_list_users.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short description or title of the todo item limited to 255 characters.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Optional detailed description of the todo item limited to 1000 characters.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Task status indicating progress phase: 'pending', 'completed', or 'deleted'.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Optional due date and time for the task, must be in the future when set.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last updated.
